scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:external: node -e 'if (!process.env.EXTERNAL_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY) throw new Error("EXTERNAL_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY is required")' && pnpm run typecheck && BASE_PATH=/ PORT=3000 VITE_EXTERNAL_DEPLOYMENT=true VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY="$EXTERNAL_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY" VITE_CLERK_PROXY_URL= pnpm --filter @workspace/greyton-murder-mysteries run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
